Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Dalton Chaise Sectional Sofa Couch, 91.5", Stone
Colors: Stone
Materials: stone
Transitional design meets exceptional comfort for everyday living in this sectional sofa. With moisture-repelling and stain-resistant fabric, it can take toddler spills and muddy paw prints, yet still add timeless style to your family room. 91.5"W x 37.5"D x 35"H Solid hardwood and laminate wood frame; polyester/nylon performance fabric Transitional style Crisp, expert tailoring and track arm design built for heavy duty wear No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
